build_hamiltonian_graph: build a Hamiltonian Graph Network that computes the Hooke's potential energy from a GraphsTuple
simulate_particle_system: simulate a Hooke's particle system by integrating graph state forward in time with Verlet integrator
generate_particle_graph: generate a fully connected graph of particles with random positions, momenta, and spring constants
compute_state_derivatives: compute time derivatives of position and momentum from a Hamiltonian function using JAX autodiff
integrate_graph_step: integrate a single timestep of a graph-based particle system using a configurable integrator
